title: incident-bot: add SLO toolkit autodiagnostics helpers and on-call runbook suggestions
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Improve on-call diagnostics by exposing SLO-related heuristics and runbook suggestions through the incident-bot and slo-toolkit integration. This PR implements helper utilities that surface prioritized runbook links, quick diagnostic checks, and lightweight telemetry hints tied to SLO violations.

Summary of changes: Adds a new slo_toolkit helpers module used by incident-bot to compute prioritized runbook suggestions, enrich runbook metadata with SLO context, and attach lightweight diagnostics snippets to on-call messages. Also adds a new ranker that orders suggestions by recent incident signal and historical hit-rate. Includes unit tests, integration tests for the incident-bot message flow, and docs for the console team and on-call runbooks.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement slo_toolkit helpers API (suggestions, hinting, priority scoring)
- [x] Wire incident-bot to call helpers when SLO alerts are posted
- [x] Add telemetry tags and metrics for sampling/priority (slo_autodiag.priority_score)
- [x] Add unit + integration tests
- [x] Update runbook docs and quicklink conventions
- [x] Validate CI and fix flakiness observed in integration tests

Operational notes: The priority ranker currently uses a decaying count of past hits and a simple heuristic based on SLO window and error budget remaining. Default sampling is conservative (5% for low-severity SLO hits, 100% for P0/P1). Config flags documented under /ops/runbooks/config. We intentionally keep the telemetry payload small and avoid sending full traces from the bot—only diagnostic pointers and short aggregated metrics.

This PR is targeted at enabling faster on-call resolution and better SRE ergonomics; follow-up PRs will add threshold tuning via the console and a canary rollout to Dedicated clusters.

release_notes:
Adds SLO toolkit helpers that let incident-bot suggest prioritized runbooks and attach lightweight diagnostics to on-call alerts. Configurable sampling and per-team decay settings added. No breaking changes.

Ops: review ops/config/runbook_defaults.yaml and adjust sampling for low-traffic teams before enabling at 100%.
notes_for_oncall: New message attachments will include a "Suggested runbooks" section with ranked links and a short summary. For noisy clusters start with 5% sampling. If runbook suggestions appear inaccurate surface examples to #oncall-feedback for tuning.
risk_assessment: Low. Changes are additive and behind conservative defaults. Priority ranking is deterministic and can be disabled via config. Telemetry payloads are small and do not include PII or full traces.
backout_plan: Revert the canary flag in ops/config/runbook_defaults.yaml and roll back the incident-bot deployment via console. Incident-bot will fall back to existing behavior (no runbook suggestions) if feature flag is off.
